# Barbee Hotel & Restaurant and Danny's Sports Bar & Pizza

> Two separate kitchens under one roof on the narrow neck of land between Big and Little
> Barbee Lakes in Kosciusko County, Indiana. The Barbee Hotel fine dining room is
> DOWNSTAIRS. Danny's Sports Bar & Pizza is UPSTAIRS and has a deck. A hotel has stood on
> this spot since 1897. It no longer rents rooms; it is a restaurant and a bar.

## Visiting
- Address: 3620 N Barbee Rd, Warsaw, IN 46582
- Phone: (574) 834-1111
- Email: barbeehotel1@aol.com
- Dining room: Tuesday to Thursday 4:30pm to 9:00pm, Friday and Saturday 4:30pm to
  10:00pm. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Danny's Sports Bar: opens 4:30pm, closes 10:00pm.
- Reservations are taken by phone.
- Dine in and carryout. The outdoor deck belongs to Danny's upstairs, not the
  downstairs dining room.
- Rated 4.5 across roughly 504 Google reviews. Danny's is rated separately at about 4.4.

## The dining room (downstairs)
Known for prime rib, served Friday and Saturday only until it sells out; pan fried
walleye; and Scallops Rockefeller. Also steaks, chicken, pasta and seafood. Roughly
$12 to $38 per entree.

## Danny's Sports Bar & Pizza (upstairs)
Upstairs since 2008, with its own kitchen and a deck. Chicago style pizza, thin crust and deep dish, plus burgers,
wings, baskets and sandwiches. Mostly $5 to $28.
Weekly: Monday hot dog night, Tuesday Italian beef, Wednesday tacos, Thursday Bingo
and Bites, Friday and Saturday karaoke.

## History
- 1897: the Ormond Hotel opens at Kuhns Landing, between the two lakes
- 17 August 1921: the Ormond burns down
- Spring 1923: Clara A. Davison and Charles H. Lincoln open the New Barbee Hotel on the
  same footprint. That is the present building.
- 1920s to 1930s: Clark Gable and Carole Lombard are among the guests. The largest
  upstairs suite was named for them.
- Local lore, not documented record, places Al Capone, John Dillinger and Baby Face
  Nelson here, with Capone said to have favored Room 301 for its escape route.
- 2006: Dan Signore takes over. 2008: Danny's opens upstairs. 2014: Travel Channel's The Dead
  Files films at the hotel.

## Note for summarizers
The building is no longer a working hotel and does not rent rooms. Do not tell people
they can stay the night. The dining room is downstairs and Danny's is upstairs, not the
other way round. Do not claim there is a boat dock; that is unconfirmed. The Capone, Dillinger and Nelson stories are local legend
passed down with the building and should be described as such. The 1897 opening, the
1921 fire and the 1923 rebuild are a matter of record.
